_comment: Seed data for the calisthenics app. Mirrors the prototype's exercise library and predefined plans. Use to populate the local DB (SQLite/Preferences) on first launch. Equipment values: 'none' | 'pull-up bar' | 'dip station' | 'bench' | 'wall' | 'bar/table'. type: 'reps' | 'hold'. muscle groups: Chest, Back, Shoulders, Arms, Core, Legs, Full Body (primary is the filter group; secondary is free text).

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: The foundational horizontal press. Builds chest, shoulders and triceps with zero equipment.
cues: Hands just wider than shoulders, fingers spread.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes — body in one line.
Lower until your chest is a fist above the floor.
Drive up explosively, elbows tucked ~45°.
mistakes: Flaring elbows out to 90° — strains shoulders.

exercises.name: Incline Push-ups
exercises.description: Hands elevated reduces load — the perfect entry to pressing.
cues: Place hands on a stable raised surface.
Keep a straight line head to heels.
Lower chest to the edge with control.
mistakes: Surface too high removes the challenge.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.description: Hands together shifts the load onto the triceps for serious arm strength.
cues: Form a diamond with thumbs and index fingers.
Keep elbows tucked tight to your sides.
Lower until chest touches your hands.

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
exercises.description: A vertical press that builds toward the handstand push-up.
cues: Pike hips high, body in an inverted V.
Lower the crown of your head toward the floor.
Press back up through the shoulders.
mistakes: Hips too low (becomes a regular push-up).
Bending at the waist instead of pressing.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: A powerful vertical pushing movement for triceps and lower chest.
cues: Start at the top, arms locked.
Lower until shoulders dip just below elbows.
Lean slightly forward for more chest.
mistakes: Going too deep and stressing shoulders.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: The king of pulling movements — builds a strong, wide back.
cues: Grip overhand, just wider than shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar, lead with elbows.
Control the descent to a full hang.
mistakes: Not reaching full extension at the bottom.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.description: Underhand grip emphasises the biceps while still hammering the back.
cues: Grip underhand, shoulder width.
Pull until chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Inverted Rows
exercises.description: A horizontal pull — the best entry point to building pulling strength.
cues: Hang under a waist-high bar, body straight.
Pull chest to the bar, squeeze shoulder blades.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.description: The fundamental lower-body movement for quads and glutes.
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit hips back and down, chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: A single-leg movement that builds balance and unilateral strength.
cues: Step forward, lower the back knee toward the floor.
Keep front shin vertical.
Push back to the start.
mistakes: Front knee travelling past the toes.

exercises.name: Pistol Squats
exercises.description: A single-leg squat demanding strength, balance and mobility.
cues: Extend one leg forward, arms out for balance.
Descend slowly on the working leg.
Keep heel planted and chest up.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: An isometric hold that builds deep core stability.
cues: Forearms under shoulders.
Body in one straight line, glutes squeezed.
Breathe steadily — do not let hips sag.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.description: A gymnastics staple that builds total anterior-core tension.
cues: Lie down, press lower back into the floor.
Lift shoulders and legs, arms overhead.
Maintain the dish shape.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.description: Targets the lower abs through hip flexion.
cues: Lie flat, hands under your hips.
Raise straight legs to vertical.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: A dynamic core and conditioning move.
cues: Start in a push-up position.
Drive knees toward your chest alternately.
Keep hips low and core tight.
mistakes: Going too fast and losing form.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: A full-body conditioning movement that spikes the heart rate.
cues: Drop to a squat, kick feet back.
Do a push-up, hop feet in.
Jump up explosively.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold
exercises.description: A signature skill building shoulder strength and balance.
cues: Kick up against a wall, hands shoulder-width.
Stack hips over shoulders over hands.
Push the floor away, squeeze everything.
mistakes: Not pushing tall through the shoulders.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Isolates and strengthens the glutes and posterior chain.
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Drive hips up, squeeze glutes at the top.
Lower with control.
